applications.title: Chat
applications.description: Talk with agents. Start a chat on any runtime and worker, in a workspace or without one, and follow every turn as it runs.

applications.title: Claude Code
applications.description: Runs Claude Code as an agent on your workers, through its Agent Client Protocol adapter. Claude Code needs a Claude subscription or an Anthropic API key, signed in on each worker.

applications.title: Directories
applications.description: Gives each workspace a plain directory of its own on a worker, kept as it is between mounts.

applications.title: Git worktrees
applications.description: Gives each workspace its own git worktree and branch beside a repository on a worker, keeps its uncommitted work when it is unmounted, and shows what changed in it to review, commit or discard.

applications.title: OpenCode
applications.description: Runs OpenCode as an agent on your workers. OpenCode works with its free models at once, and with your own model providers once you sign in to them on a worker.
